scope: Known semantic request to exact output fields; fresh synthetic reference-runtime test, NOT historical replication, W2, R2 or raw Persian understanding
primary_metric: Exact final action, requested role sets, entity text and value text; invalid/rejected/HTTP failures count as incorrect
comparisons: Direct literal generation vs external reference architecture
JSON refs vs alias refs with identical tables and resolver
limitations: Alias output is a benchmark selection notation, not the native SAXIL tokenizer or W2 grammar
Same Qwen family but 9B hosted model is not the original trained 4B checkpoint
Inference seed repeats are not independent training replications
All semantic targets are already known by the host; a deterministic realizer is also sufficient
Only reference arms omit exact literals from model context; this is an architecture comparison
Latency is concurrent external API wall time, not end-to-end voice latency
Runtime guards cannot detect a wrong valid same-role reference; gold scoring must do so
